description: This PHP script handles updating relationships between entities in the vtiger CRM system, processing request parameters, and redirecting accordingly.

classes.name: CRMEntity
classes.description: Represents a CRM entity, providing method to retrieve an instance based on the current module.

methods.name: vtlib_purify
methods.description: Sanitizes input data from user requests.

methods.name: getParentTab
methods.description: Retrieves the parent tab context for the current request.

methods.name: CRMEntity::getInstance
methods.description: Gets an instance of CRMEntity for the specified module.

methods.name: relateEntities
methods.description: Establishes relationships between entities based on provided IDs and module context.
